# ArchitecturalGrounding

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The principle that computational semantics are derived from the physical and logical topology of the network, not just from algorithms. Shifts TCC design from abstract computation to topology-first engineering, enabling more efficient and robust in-network processing.
